tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /ngor mkhan po dpal ldan don grub kyi gsung 'bum dkar chag/ 001 mkhas grub dpal ldan don grub kyi gsung 'bum dkar chag 002 thugs rje chen po gtso 'khor gsum sa lugs kyi cho ga 'phags pa mnyes byed/ 003 gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma'i chos skor gyi rnam gzhag rab tu gsal ba/ 004 dpal kyai rdo rje la brten pa'i las bzhi'i sbyin sreg gi rnam par bshad pa ye shes me phung / 005 mngon par rtogs pa rin po che'i ljon shing mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos kyi sngon 'gro rgya cher bshad pa blo gsal rab dga'/ 006 'byung po 'dul byed kyi rjes gnang gi bla ma brgyud pa la gsol ba 'debs pa'i rab tu byed pa/ 007 bar do ngo sprod kyi gdams pa mthar lam gsal byed/ 008 kun dga' bkra shis kyis dris lan don mtshan lnga pa/ 009 legs pa chos 'phel gyis dris lan nor bu'i 'phreng ba bcas bzhugs so//
